title: Build a simple chatbot flow
description: Create an automated WhatsApp reply flow using the visual workflow editor

steps.title: Go to Workflows
steps.instruction: Click the Workflows icon (🤖) in the sidebar.

steps.title: Create a new workflow
steps.instruction: Click '+ Create Workflow' to open the visual editor.

steps.title: Add a trigger event
steps.instruction: Drag 'Incoming WhatsApp' from the Events palette onto the canvas as your trigger.

steps.title: Add a response
steps.instruction: Drag 'Response message' onto the canvas and connect it to your trigger.

steps.title: Save your flow
steps.instruction: Click Save to activate your new chatbot flow. It will start responding automatically.
